newsitem.title: UK: Wilson Bowden upbeat on '97 after yr results.
newsitem.headline: Wilson Bowden upbeat on '97 after yr results.

text.p: British property developer and housebuilder Wilson Bowden Plc said on Monday it was optimistic about prospects this year given current market conditions.
The company earlier reported that pre-tax profit for 1996 had risen nearly 39 percent to a record 41.0 million stg. It raised its total dividend to 11.0p per share from 10.05p previously.

"I believe there may well be a slight pause in activity during the forthcoming election campaign, but there is no reason to fear any longer term damage if the current underlying strength of our market is maintained," said David Wilson, chairman and chief executive of Wilson Bowden in a statement.
The UK election is widely expected to take place on May 1.
Wilson Bowden also said it was hopeful that 1997 result would be lifted if it successfully concluded talks on a retail project in Edinburgh.
Overall results for 1996 were aided by a nine-month contribution from recently acquired Trencherwood.
